guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table on mobile without horizontal page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic <table> with <caption>/<thead>/<th>; wrap the table in a scroll container (overflow:auto) that is keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0) and named as a region (role=region + aria-labelledby the caption) so narrow screens scroll the table, not the page; keep short cells legible rather than crushing them.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied to the new compat table: .table-wrap (shared overflow-x:auto scroller) with tabindex=0, role=region, aria-labelledby=compat-caption; captioned table with thead/tbody; the browser and version columns are white-space:nowrap so they are not broken mid-word by the global overflow-wrap:anywhere guard. Exception: sticky headers / stacked-card layout not adopted — a 4-row, 3-column table does not need them and the shared design system has no such component (would mean new shared CSS, off-limits to a leaf writer).

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy loaded cross-origin iframe embed sandbox
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Defer offscreen third-party embeds (loading=lazy) so they do not compete with the page's LCP resources; give embeds explicit dimensions to avoid layout shift.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase iframe is loading=lazy with a fixed height=520 and width:100%, below the fold; it carries the routine's mandated sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" + referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" pair and a descriptive title.
